This is obviously not a very pleasant type of object to work with.
On the other hand, there are lots of examples where it is quite clear
how you work with it. The only example we have so far is that of
the <MATH_0001>-category whose objects are a given collection of categories,
<MATH_0002>-morphisms are functors between these categories,
and <MATH_0003>-morphisms are natural transformations of functors, see
Section <REF_0001>.
